properties.source: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain, via NOAA ERD ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71): annual-mean sea-level pressure contoured at 1018 hPa between 10 and 48 deg N/S, closed and smoothed, clipped to the sea with Natural Earth 50m land and simplified by script. Marine data only, so the cells stop at the coast; the antimeridian splits the North Pacific cell in two.
refs: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly LTM 1971-2000, ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71 (accessed 2026-10-12)
